method: --load: edit-buffer dump (7F 00) only. The user STOREs on the FM3 to a location in 424..426. --verify: one read-only stored-dump request (fn=0x03) for that location. The script never stores and never sets.

storeLocation.note: The user stored to 427 (outside the planned 424..426); 427 held the T34A CTRL SCENES test preset, which is regenerable from tools/fm3/t34-controllers-sources-build.mjs.

beforeStore.types: A Ya-Ya Delay, B Space Tape, C L-C-R-C, D Centaurus X-3

afterReload.types: A Ya-Ya Delay, B Space Tape, C L-C-R-C, D Centaurus X-3

findings.storeRoundTrip: multidelayTypes channel templates (and the Mix control on A, and the scene channels) survive STORE and reload unchanged.
findings.recordOrder: On STORE the FM3 writes the block records in its own order: the inserted Multi Delay record (appended last by the generator) is stored after Send. Each record keeps its channel data; only the per-record link words (next record id, its scene channels and size) differ. Loading the generator order works (T36/T38 load), so this is cosmetic. Since 0.3.58 the generator uses the device order (fm3-record-order): the same spec now produces the stored body byte for byte.

meaning: multidelayTypes is device-confirmed for load + edit buffer (T36) and STORE/reload (T38).
notMeasured: Types other than the eight in T36/T38 on the device through the generator (their images are the T35 reads)
